title: Users may experience delays due to increased load on bychan keyspace affecting system performance

updates.body:
This issue is now resolved for all users.
Current status and recent actions taken:  We've completed rolling back the change to address the issue impacting core Slack functionality, including launching Slack, sending messages, loading threads, and other related actions.
Scope: All Slack enterprise customers.
Previous impact to end users: Users experienced issues with channel-related operations, including delays or failures when loading channels or retrieving channel membership lists.
We apologize for any disruptions to your day.

updates.body: We're aware of an issue affecting Slack. Some users who have set a custom status to expire at a specific time are finding that their status is not automatically clearing as expected. We're actively investigating and we'll provide an update as soon as we have more information available.

Resolved
This issue is now resolved for all users.
Current status and recent actions taken: Custom statuses set to expire at a specific time are now clearing as expected. The issue self-resolved when the next scheduled expiration job successfully processed the affected users.
Scope: Some external users globally were affected. Users on desktop were impacted; the issue was not reproducible internally or across test workspaces.
Previous impact to end users: Some users may have experienced custom statuses that did not automatically clear at their scheduled expiration time.
Required resolution steps: No steps required.
We apologize for any disruptions to your day.

updates.body:
Some users are having trouble loading Threads in Slack, this is affecting Windows and Chrome users. Users may receive an error asking them to ‘Try Again’.
We apologize for the inconvenience and will report back as more information becomes available.
We’re still investigating these issues with Threads not loading. No additional information to share just yet, but we’ll keep you posted as soon as we have an update.

Further investigation confirms that the issue impacting Thread loading has been self- resolved, and our team will continue to investigate to ensure that this doesn’t reoccur. We apologize for the trouble today and thank you for your patience.
